frames.world: ENU (x forward at start, y left, z up)

video_sync.note: video_t = reference + sim_t * time_scale; None/approximate if speed was overridden

assumptions: Drone parameters, drone radius, safety margin, start altitude and floor are ASSUMED values.
Obstacle metric size comes from configuration, not measurement: size_is_assumed=True, fov_is_assumed=True.
Controller reads the true simulated state (no sensor noise). Wind: none.

wind.convention: direction the wind blows TOWARD; azimuth from +x (forward) toward +y (left) in the horizontal plane, elevation from the horizontal plane toward +z (up); w = V (cos(el)cos(az), cos(el)sin(az), sin(el))
wind.model: steady wind + per-axis Ornstein-Uhlenbeck gusts (exact discretisation, seeded); drag F = -c_d |v - w| (v - w)
